site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: El País confirms 10 possible infections and 3 deaths aboard vessel as of 11 May; Andes variant identified with no new mutations, high similarity to Argentina 2018-19 strains. No new infections reported since containment measures implemented; vessel en route Rotterdam with 30 skeleton crew + Dutch nurse for full decontamination.

site.name: AMSTERDAM / NIJMEGEN / ROTTERDAM
site.desc: British Case 3 (Anstee) transferred to Netherlands after improving in South Africa. Dutch crew member (41, confirmed) treated at Radboud UMC Nijmegen. Netherlands lab PCR-confirmed German woman died of Andes virus. MV Hondius sailing to Rotterdam post-Tenerife for full disinfection with skeleton crew of 30 + Dutch nurse aboard.

site.name: NEBRASKA
site.desc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC National Quarantine Unit (NQU) received two Americans transported in biocontainment units: one asymptomatic PCR-positive per AP News 11 May, one symptomatic. 17 Americans total repatriated via State Dept airlift from Tenerife to Offutt AFB; CDC says widespread US transmission unlikely. Post-assessment, asymptomatic passengers may opt for 42-day home self-monitoring.
